summary: Verified quarterly subscription plan support end-to-end (admin editor, backend models, plans endpoint, create flow). Found & fixed 2 backend bugs that prevented quarterly from working at runtime: (a) subscription_controller.create_subscription had a stale plan-type allowlist (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly) that rejected 'quarterly' with 400 and still accepted 'daily'; (b) subscription_service.plan_preview iterated the same stale list so GET /subscriptions/plans/{service_id} hid 'quarterly' from the customer. After fixes, all 5 backend tests pass. Admin plan editor (/admin → Services → New Service → Variants & Plans → Recurring Subscription Service) renders exactly Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly/Yearly with correct data-testid='sub-wd-{plan_type}' and no Daily row — confirmed in browser. Static review of /app/Customer/app/(customer)/subscriptions.tsx matches spec (SchedulePicker wired to startDate+time, book() creates sub then POST /pay/order then openPreparedOrder with purpose='subscription', no TextInput import, dynamic plan labels).

critical.issue: Endpoint does not exist (404). Route not declared in subscription_routes.py and no pay_mock function in subscription_controller.py. The Customer Expo app subscriptions.tsx book() falls back to /pay/mock when the gateway returns 409 (no gateway configured) — that fallback now fails silently and the subscription stays unpaid. seed_maid_partners.py (line 97) also calls sc.pay_mock which does not exist (would crash seed). Multiple existing tests (test_iter141_session_flow, test_iter149_regression, test_subscription_module) also still invoke /pay/mock.

minor.issue: SubscriptionCreate.plan_type default is still 'monthly' with doc-comment 'daily | weekly | monthly | yearly' — update comment to 'weekly | monthly | quarterly | yearly'.
PLAN_DEFAULT_DURATION still contains stale 'daily':1 entry (harmless but inconsistent with PLAN_TYPES removal of daily).

integration_issues.issue: openPreparedOrder failure path or no-gateway branch calls /subscriptions/{id}/pay/mock which returns 404 — subscription remains pending_payment and user sees 'Subscription active!' toast without actual activation.

issues: Doc-comment at top still says 'pick a plan (Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Yearly)' — update to Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly/Yearly.
Empty-state feature bullet 'Daily attendance' is a user-facing promise of daily service and OK, but just note the word daily is used for marketing copy, not a plan type.

action_items: Add POST /api/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/pay/mock endpoint (dev-only mock payment activate) in routes/subscription_routes.py + controller function pay_mock (mirrors _activate). Required by Customer Expo app fallback, seed script, and legacy tests.
Update doc comment in models/subscription.py SubscriptionCreate (plan_type) and in Customer/app/(customer)/subscriptions.tsx header to drop 'daily'.
Consider removing stale 'daily' key from PLAN_DEFAULT_DURATION.
critical_code_review_comments: subscription_controller.create_subscription had plan_type validation list hardcoded instead of using models.subscription.PLAN_TYPES — same stale list duplicated in subscription_service.plan_preview. Replace both with `if plan_type not in PLAN_TYPES` to avoid future drift (I've fixed by updating both lists to the current set weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly).

The admin PUT /api/catalog/services/{id} accepts an entire service dict including subscription_plans — no server-side validation that plan_type values ∈ PLAN_TYPES. An admin could still persist a legacy 'daily' plan which plan_preview would silently drop. Add Pydantic validation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin editor renders expected plans; customer app static review passes)

seed_data_creation: Patched existing Full-time Maid subscription-capable service via PUT /api/catalog/services/{id} to add priced weekly=₹1500, monthly=₹5000, quarterly=₹14000, yearly=₹50000 plans so /subscriptions/plans returns a priced quarterly plan for booking tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend quarterly flow works after my fixes to subscription_controller.py & subscription_service.py — see test_iter218_quarterly_subs.py. The remaining HIGH-priority bug is that POST /api/subscriptions/{id}/pay/mock returns 404 (route missing). The Customer app's dev-fallback path and seed_maid_partners both rely on it. Admin UI editor at Variants & Plans tab renders Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly/Yearly correctly. The Customer Expo subscriptions.tsx static review matches the spec (SchedulePicker wired, openPreparedOrder on real gateway, pay/mock fallback intent is correct — but target endpoint is missing).
rca of the issue: When PLAN_TYPES was changed from ['daily','weekly','monthly','yearly'] to ['weekly','monthly','quarterly','yearly'] in models/subscription.py, two downstream string literals that duplicated the old list were NOT updated: (1) subscription_controller.create_subscription line 48 — hardcoded allowlist still had 'daily' and no 'quarterly', so POST /api/subscriptions {plan_type:'quarterly'} returned 400 Invalid plan type while plan_type:'daily' was accepted and even priced. (2) subscription_service.plan_preview line 172 iterator — same stale list filtered 'quarterly' out of GET /api/subscriptions/plans/{service_id}. Fix: replaced both lists with the new set (weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly). Preferable long-term fix is to import PLAN_TYPES from models.subscription so there is a single source of truth.
